fusions.name: Pitch Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses a pitch-soaked arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Burning Rain
fusions.desc: Looses 5 lit arrows in a wide spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 5 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tracer Shafts
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far. For the first 8 seconds, lit arrows strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tinder String
fusions.desc: Conjures a bow with a burning string. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 6%, and every arrow from it sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
